digest.component_or_area: LLM provider construction seam in run()
propositions: Provider construction is an inline special case in run() branching on the provider name, forcing a new branch per provider.
A per-run ProviderSession centralizes provider construction behind a provider_factory callable matching pydantic-ai's infer_model hook signature.
ProviderSession owns lifecycle of retrying httpx.AsyncClient instances via a _closeables list, closing them on context-manager exit including on exceptions.
The Anthropic construction moves verbatim into an anthropic builder with no behavior change (retrying transport, max_retries=0, proxy bypass, timeout preserved).
An unregistered provider name must raise LLMConfigError listing registered providers rather than a KeyError.
The model_override path bypasses the factory, constructs no client, and the session closes nothing.
